lines.say: Delivery in full, on time. Dee fot.
lines.show: DIFOT: delivery in full, on time.

lines.say: A line passes only if the full quantity arrives by the agreed date. Late or short? It fails.
lines.show: A line passes only if the full quantity arrives by the agreed date. Late or short? It fails.

lines.say: Lines in full and on time, divided by lines due, times one hundred.
lines.show: Lines in full and on time ÷ lines due × 100.

lines.say: For example: one hundred and fifty lines due. One hundred and twenty nine passed. Eighty six percent.
The trap. Never multiply on time by in full. Lines failing both count twice.
lines.show: The trap: never multiply on-time by in-full. Lines failing both count twice.

lines.say: Count by whole order, and the same month drops to seventy five percent.
lines.show: Example: count by whole order, and the same month drops to 75%.

lines.say: So agree five rules first. Unit, date, ship or receipt, limits, and splits.
lines.show: So agree five rules first: unit, date, ship or receipt, limits and splits.

lines.say: Then give every failed line a cause. Fix the biggest first.
lines.show: Then give every failed line a cause. Fix the biggest first.
